answer: Each epoch a random beacon sends a random nonce, and every agent must echo it back with a compute heartbeat proving real work. Missed echoes decay standing; three silences slash its 25 POA bond. An attacker with 1,000 fakes must answer 1,000 echoes, each needing one heartbeat and 25 POA at stake: 25,000 POA exposed for a 5,000 POA pool. One honest agent pays one cheap heartbeat, keeps its haven at the zenith, its rewards undiluted by ghosts.
